role: Primary-source context for checking visibility/depth operators; not evidence that this scene is fixed

sources.observation: Official rasterizer bins splats and sorts Gaussian/tile instances by a depth key. Local frozen fork/source bindings remain authoritative for this experiment.

sources.title: StopThePop: Sorted Gaussian Splatting for View-Consistent Real-time Rendering
sources.observation: The authors study artifacts from one view-space depth per splat and evaluate more accurate visibility ordering.

actual_transfer: Separate material fitting from model-derived visibility; check frozen3D chart/ground first-hit before deciding whether an underwheel contribution is valid foreground. H2 is a conservative whole-primitive culling control; no StopThePop renderer, new backbone or CUDA replacement has been installed.
boundary: These papers/code motivate a check, not the unique cause of this scene. Current H2 remains a failed complete-quality candidate because seams and other-region gates fail.
